text: OK. so now, when i go into the model. and pick the paint layer, the paint is not there.
resolution: Paint not showing in the mesh editor on open. Verified the data is 100% intact: every painted model's current paintRef maps to a present, valid 1024x1024 PNG blob in the compacted store (pepes mdl-mqjo0ys2-3sw paintRef 13582d0470 confirmed). So this is NOT data loss and NOT caused by the store compaction (req_1556) — it's a restore-on-open gap that is PRE-EXISTING (the prior 444MB snapshot already contained only 1 of 6 current paint blobs). The compiled prop shows paint because that reads the separate, intact cooked-asset store; the editor restores from model-stream state. A fully rebuilt fresh host (zig-out/bin/hmsc-int, includes the paint-GC) still showed the old model grey, while NEWLY painted models save AND restore fine — so the system works going forward; only pre-existing blobs fail to restore on a cold open. User accepted this for now ('i painted a new one tho and it seems to save which is fine'). Full diagnosis + a fix-investigation starting point (StudioViewport restore useEffect ~line 1077 + meshPaintTexture restorePaint) is documented in the handoff /tmp/handoff-20260621-123338-texture-slots-req-1542-phases-2-3.md under 'Known open issue'. Store backup at ~/store-backup-20260621-050018-model/. Not chasing further unless asked.
